label: prop:ordering-jet-compatibility
title: The admissible ordering extends through the jet tower
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with braiding-induced ordering \prec_c on the Hecke basis of A (temporal braiding, axiom 5). Let A_0 = A \hookrightarrow A_1 \hookrightarrow A_2 \hookrightarrow \cdots be the recursive brane tower (recursive brane tower), with A_{n+1} = J^1(A_n) (jet prolongation). We have:

  1. (Extension.) At each level n, the jet prolongation \ell_n \colon A_n \hookrightarrow A_{n+1} induces an admissible ordering \prec_{n+1} on the Hecke basis of A_{n+1} that extends \prec_n:
  a \prec_n b \implies \ell_n(a) \prec_{n+1} \ell_n(b), \qquad a, b \in A_n.

  1. (Compatibility with multiplication.) The ordering \prec_{n+1} satisfies left and right compatibility. If a \prec_{n+1} b, then c \cdot a \prec_{n+1} c \cdot b and a \cdot d \prec_{n+1} b \cdot d for all c, d \in A_{n+1} (admissible system).

  2. (Well-foundedness.) Each \prec_n is well-founded. There are no infinite descending chains in the Hecke basis of A_n.

  3. (Direct limit.) The direct limit algebra \mathcal{A}_\infty = \varinjlim \mathrm{End}(A_n) (direct limit algebra) carries a filtered admissible ordering \prec_\infty = \bigcup_n \prec_n. Every element a \in \mathcal{A}_\infty has a well-defined leading monomial \mathrm{LM}(a) with respect to \prec_\infty. The Gröbner--Shirshov reduction algorithm terminates on every element of \mathcal{A}_\infty that belongs to a finite level A_n.
